root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The `err.message` pointer consumed by the read-from-memory `qWarning()` must not already be the alias invalidated by `heif_context_free(ctx)` on the same error path.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Once `HEIFHandler::ensureDecoder()` enters the `if (err.code)` read-from-memory error path, it must keep the `err.message` alias live until the `qWarning()` error log consumes it. The logged pointer must not be the same `err.message` alias whose lifetime the immediately preceding `heif_context_free(ctx)` ended.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable order frees `ctx` first and then logs `err.message`, so the log consumes exactly the alias already invalidated by `heif_context_free(ctx)`. The fixed order records the same log event before the free, leaving the previously-freed alias tracker null when the protected event executes.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable trace records `read_error_log.message_ptr == read_error_log.previous_freed_message_ptr`, while the fixed trace reaches `read_error_log` with `previous_freed_message_ptr=(nil)` and only frees the same alias afterwards at `read_error_cleanup`.

nodes.state: Immediately after `heif_context_free(ctx)` on the read-from-memory error path, the captured `err.message` pointer is the alias whose backing libheif error-buffer storage has just been released.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `ASSERT_EVT point=read_error_cleanup freed_message_ptr=...` immediately before the crashing `qWarning()` sink.

nodes.state: The read-from-memory `qWarning()` consumes `err.message`; Qt converts that C string through `QString::fromUtf8` and `strlen`, which is the AddressSanitizer-reported heap-use-after-free read.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable trace reaches `read_error_log` immediately before the saved ASan stack `__interceptor_strlen -> fromUtf8 -> operator<< -> HEIFHandler::ensureDecoder`.

edges.relation: The exact `err.message` pointer captured immediately after `heif_context_free(ctx)` is the same pointer later forwarded to the read-from-memory `qWarning()` sink on the vulnerable path.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `read_error_cleanup.freed_message_ptr == read_error_log.message_ptr` with ordered event indices 0 -> 1.
